chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Hammad from Hariz from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the saying of Allah, Exalted and Mighty: 'Remember Allah during known days.' He said: The Takbir (saying Allahu Akbar) during the Days of Tashriq from the Dhuhr prayer, and whoever stays in Mina and prays Dhuhr and Asr there, let him recite the Takbir.

key_terms.بِمِنًى: In Mina (the location of the ritual)
key_terms.مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ: From/after the prayer (indicating the time of recitation)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on reciting Takbir during the Days of Tashriq in Mina?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-istibsar clarifies that the 'known days' (Ayam al-Ma'dudat) in Surah Al-Baqarah refer specifically to the Days of Tashriq, linking the ritual of Hajj to Quranic exegesis. It establishes the obligation of reciting Takbir after the Dhuhr prayer for those remaining in Mina, a practice that distinguishes the pilgrim's status during these specific days of celebration and remembrance.
